content.user_title: Convert Website Images Into Frontend Code
content.value_statement: Visual website builds often lose fidelity between reference images and frontend implementation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through image-first analysis and faithful implementation.
actual_capabilities: Enforces image-first workflow for visually important website tasks.
Recommends separate section images for multi-section Codex builds.
Guides extraction of text, typography, spacing, colors, buttons, and components.
Directs fresh regeneration when section details are unclear.
Provides rules for clean heroes, responsive first views, and fewer nested boxes.
Supports faithful frontend implementation from generated visual references.
limitations: Requires image generation access for the intended workflow.
Focused on visual frontend and marketing websites, not backend architecture.
Does not include executable tooling or automated visual diff checks.
Ambiguous image details may still require human design judgment.

use_cases.title: Build a Premium Landing Page
use_cases.description: Generate section references, analyze them, and implement a polished marketing page with consistent visual language.

use_cases.title: Improve Design Fidelity
use_cases.description: Use generated reference images as a visual source before coding the final website experience.

use_cases.title: Create Clear Section References
use_cases.description: Generate separate, readable images for hero, pricing, testimonial, and CTA sections before implementation starts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Hero Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for one visual section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a premium hero section for [product]. Generate the visual reference first, analyze text, spacing, color, and buttons, then implement it.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Landing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a [number]-section landing page for [brand]. Create one image per section, analyze each image, then build the frontend.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Before Coding
prompt_templates.prompt: Regenerate unclear sections before coding. Extract typography, layout, component logic, color, spacing, and visible copy from each reference image.

prompt_templates.title: Implement a Full Visual System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a complete site.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 10-section website for [brand]. Generate section references, add detail images where text is unclear, extract a design system, then implement faithfully.

output_examples.input: A founder asks for one premium hero section for an AI product.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates a dedicated hero reference image, extracts hierarchy, spacing, CTA style, colors, and then implements the section.

output_examples.input: A team needs an eight-section landing page with strong visual polish.
output_examples.output: The assistant generates separate section references, analyzes each one, keeps visual consistency, and builds the full page from those references.

output_examples.input: A generated pricing section has text that is too small to read.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates a clearer detail image, extracts pricing labels and card structure, and avoids guessing important content.

best_practices: Use one large, readable reference image for each important website section.
Analyze typography, spacing, color, text, buttons, and layout before coding.
Regenerate unclear sections instead of guessing from tiny or cropped images.
anti_patterns: Do not begin visual website work with freeform coding when image generation is available.
Do not compress many sections into one unreadable image board.
Do not replace distinctive reference designs with generic card rows and default layouts.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create visual website references and translate them into frontend implementations.

faq.question: Does it require image generation?
faq.answer: Yes, the main workflow depends on generating and analyzing images before coding.

faq.question: Can it support multi-section websites?
faq.answer: Yes, it recommends one clear image per section when that improves readability.

faq.question: Is it only for Codex?
faq.answer: No, it supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it include runnable scripts?
faq.answer: No, the reviewed skill is instructional content in SKILL.md only.

faq.question: How does it reduce design drift?
faq.answer: It requires image analysis before implementation and keeps the generated references as the visual source.
